title: Jordan Love: Sunday's game "definitely up there" with best I've ever played

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jordan Love: Sunday's game "definitely up there" with best I've ever played
sources.description: Packers quarterback Jordan Love ran for a touchdown to stake the team to a lead 100 seconds into Sunday's game in New England, but he used his right arm as his main weapon over the rest of the 45-27 win.
